title: Public demo instance with no execution authority
summary: Decision dossier for a publicly browsable, execution-locked Agent Studio demo built from completed and deployed scenario snapshots. In addition to the pinned two-project seed, Dossier lifecycle, replay, security, hosting, and reset decisions, it defines a six-case scenario pool, recommends SVG Pelican, Shift Ledger, and The Deep Blue as the first benchmark wave, specifies scripted Orchestrator context-chat runs, a four-category TokenEconomy ledger, immutable Result Dossiers and run history, per-case token caps, staged model comparisons, and clear ownership across the demo, Token Economy, the Agent Studio website, and independently deployed outputs. [Operator approved 2026-08-17: implement as recommended; slices S1-S5 cut as AGT-2666..2670. Implementation state in section 14: S1 (seed and gallery), S2 (hard execution profile), S3 (replay-only Runner), S4 (public read-only edge), and S5 (scrub, bundle, reset contract) are delivered; S6 (launch rehearsal) is not started, so the launch invariant is not met yet.] [Curation 2026-09-07: stays in the active list, not closable - S6 (launch rehearsal) is still open, and no dossier moves to History while an attached slice is open. The deliveries of S2 and S3 are confirmed in develop (PublicDemoExecutionProfileTests, DemoReplayAdmissionPolicy, DemoReplayTraceSignature). The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" are not part of the descriptor vocabulary (status: active | decision-pending | decided | documented | archived, phase: informational | shaping | testing | decision-ready) and made this dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; corrected to decided/testing, the decided-and-under-delivery pair that keeps the dossier in the active list.]
